content.json:
# Azure update and software inventory
SCCM-inspired reporting from Change Tracking and Inventory data in Log Analytics.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query:
where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| project id, name
| sort by name asc

parameters.name: AzureSubscription
parameters.label: Azure subscription
parameters.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software"
| parse _ResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/" *
| where isnotempty(AzureSubscriptionId)
| distinct AzureSubscriptionId
| project value = AzureSubscriptionId, label = AzureSubscriptionId
| sort by label asc

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource group
parameters.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software"
| parse _ResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/" *
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where isnotempty(AzureResourceGroup)
| distinct AzureResourceGroup
| project value = AzureResourceGroup, label = AzureResourceGroup
| sort by label asc

parameters.name: Region
parameters.label: Region
parameters.query:
let InventoryResources = ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software"
| extend ResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse ResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/" *
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| distinct ResourceId;
arg("").Resources
| where type in~ ("microsoft.compute/virtualmachines", "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines")
| project ResourceId = tolower(id), Region = location
| join kind=inner InventoryResources on ResourceId
| where isnotempty(Region)
| distinct Region
| project value = Region, label = Region
| sort by label asc

parameters.name: OperatingSystem
parameters.label: Operating system
parameters.description: Scopes the baseline compliance section to machines running the selected OS, so a KB is only evaluated where it applies.
parameters.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OSType =~ "Windows"
| where isnotempty(OSName)
| distinct OSName
| project value = OSName, label = OSName
| sort by label asc

content.title: Inventory summary

content.json:
## Inventory health
Comparable to SCCM scan-state and inventory-recency reports.

content.query:
let MachineOperatingSystems = Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(OSName) or isnotempty(OSType)
| where isnotempty(_ResourceId) or isnotempty(Computer)
| extend OSJoinKey = iff(isnotempty(_ResourceId), strcat("resource:", tolower(_ResourceId)), strcat("computer:", tolower(Computer)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OSName, OSType, OSMajorVersion, OSMinorVersion) by OSJoinKey
| extend OSVersion = strcat(OSMajorVersion, iff(isnotempty(OSMajorVersion) and isnotempty(OSMinorVersion), strcat(".", OSMinorVersion), ""))
| extend OSLabel = coalesce(OSName, OSType)
| project OSJoinKey, OperatingSystem = iff(isnotempty(OSVersion) and not(OSLabel contains OSVersion), strcat(OSLabel, " (", OSVersion, ")"), OSLabel);
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software"
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| summarize LastInventory = max(TimeGenerated), ResourceId = take_any(_ResourceId), SubscriptionId = take_any(AzureSubscriptionId), ResourceGroup = take_any(AzureResourceGroup), ResourceType = take_any(AzureResourceType) by Computer
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| extend InventoryAgeDays = datetime_diff("day", now(), LastInventory)
| extend InventoryState = iff(LastInventory >= ago({InventoryFreshness}), "Current", "Stale")
| extend OSJoinKey = iff(isnotempty(ResourceId), strcat("resource:", tolower(ResourceId)), strcat("computer:", tolower(Computer)))
| join kind=leftouter MachineOperatingSystems on OSJoinKey
| extend OperatingSystem = coalesce(OperatingSystem, "Unknown")
| extend VMType = case(ResourceType =~ "Azure VM", "Azure", ResourceType =~ "Arc server", "Arc", "Unknown")
| project Computer, OperatingSystem, ['Server Type'] = VMType, InventoryState, LastInventory, InventoryAgeDays, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, ResourceType, ResourceId
| sort by InventoryState asc, LastInventory desc
content.title: Inventory state by computer

content.json: ## Baseline compliance Disclaimer: This section returns no results unless you enter one or more KBs in the Required KB baseline filter. > **Applicability-aware:** Enter comma-separated KB identifiers, such as `KB5030219,KB5030310`. Only machines where a baseline KB **applies** are shown: applicability = installed (Change Tracking inventory) or pending (Azure Update Manager assessment). A machine is **Noncompliant** when a baseline KB is assessed as needed but not installed, **Compliant** when installed, and excluded when the KB neither applies nor is pending. Use the **Operating system** filter to scope to the OS a KB targets.

content.query:
let Baseline = materialize(print Items = split('{RequiredKBs}', ",")
| mv-expand RequiredKB = Items to typeof(string)
| extend RequiredKB = toupper(replace_string(RequiredKB, " ", ""))
| where RequiredKB matches regex @"^KB[0-9]{6,8}$"
| distinct RequiredKB);
let InScopeMachines = materialize(ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software"
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| extend NormalizedComputer = tolower(iff(Computer has ".", substring(Computer, 0, indexof(Computer, ".")), Computer))
| where "*" in~ ({OperatingSystem}) or NormalizedComputer in (Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where OSName in~ ({OperatingSystem}) | project NC = tolower(iff(Computer has ".", substring(Computer, 0, indexof(Computer, ".")), Computer)) | distinct NC)
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({InventoryFreshness})
| summarize LastInventory = max(TimeGenerated), ResourceId = take_any(_ResourceId) by NormalizedComputer, Computer);
let InstalledPairs = materialize(ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software" and SoftwareType =~ "Patch"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({InventoryFreshness})
| extend KB = toupper(extract(@"KB[0-9]{6,8}", 0, SoftwareName))
| where isnotempty(KB)
| extend NormalizedComputer = tolower(iff(Computer has ".", substring(Computer, 0, indexof(Computer, ".")), Computer))
| project PairKey = strcat(NormalizedComputer, "|", KB)
| distinct PairKey);
let Evaluated = materialize(InScopeMachines
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (Baseline | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| extend PairKey = strcat(NormalizedComputer, "|", RequiredKB)
| extend IsInstalled = PairKey in (InstalledPairs)
| extend IsPending = PairKey in (arg("").patchassessmentresources | where type endswith "/softwarepatches" | extend AssessId = tolower(id) | parse AssessId with "/subscriptions/" a "/resourcegroups/" b "/providers/" c "/" d "/" ServerName "/patchassessmentresults/" * | where isnotempty(properties.kbId) | project PairKey = strcat(tolower(ServerName), "|", toupper(strcat("KB", tostring(properties.kbId)))))
| extend AppliesTo = IsInstalled or IsPending
| where AppliesTo);
let Compliance = Evaluated
| summarize MissingUpdates = countif(IsPending and not(IsInstalled)) by NormalizedComputer
| extend ComplianceState = iff(MissingUpdates == 0, "Compliant", "Noncompliant");
union
    (print Value = todouble(toscalar(Baseline | count)) | extend Metric = "Baseline updates"),
    (Compliance | summarize Value = todouble(countif(ComplianceState == "Compliant")) | extend Metric = "Compliant computers"),
    (Compliance | summarize Value = todouble(countif(ComplianceState == "Noncompliant")) | extend Metric = "Noncompliant computers"),
    (Compliance | summarize Total = count(), CompliantCount = countif(ComplianceState == "Compliant") | project Value = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * CompliantCount / Total, 1)) | extend Metric = "Compliance percent")
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Compliance 1 - Overall compliance

let InstalledPairs = materialize(ConfigurationData

| extend NormalizedComputer = tolower(iff(Computer has ".", substring(Computer, 0, indexof(Computer, ".")), Computer))
| project PairKey = strcat(NormalizedComputer, "|", KB)
| distinct PairKey);
let Evaluated = materialize(InScopeMachines

| extend PairKey = strcat(NormalizedComputer, "|", RequiredKB)

| extend IsPending = PairKey in (arg("").patchassessmentresources | where type endswith "/softwarepatches" | extend AssessId = tolower(id) | parse AssessId with "/subscriptions/" a "/resourcegroups/" b "/providers/" c "/" d "/" ServerName "/patchassessmentresults/" * | where isnotempty(properties.kbId) | project PairKey = strcat(tolower(ServerName), "|", toupper(strcat("KB", tostring(properties.kbId)))))
| extend AppliesTo = IsInstalled or IsPending
| where AppliesTo);
Evaluated
| summarize RequiredUpdates = countif(AppliesTo), InstalledUpdates = countif(IsInstalled), MissingUpdates = countif(IsPending and not(IsInstalled)), MissingKBs = make_set_if(RequiredKB, IsPending and not(IsInstalled)), LastInventory = max(LastInventory), ResourceId = take_any(ResourceId) by Computer
| extend ComplianceState = iff(MissingUpdates == 0, "Compliant", "Noncompliant")
| project Computer, ComplianceState, RequiredUpdates, InstalledUpdates, MissingUpdates, MissingKBs, LastInventory, ResourceId
| sort by ComplianceState asc, Computer asc
content.title: Compliance 5 and 7 - Computer compliance details

content.json:
## Installed update inventory
Inventory equivalents for SCCM per-update and per-computer reports. Dates are observation times from `ConfigurationData`, not deployment timestamps.

The 2026-Oct security release snapshot maps Microsoft CVEs to remediation KBs from the public Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) CVRF feed. Use the table filter to find a KB or CVE. Run `scripts/Update-MsrcSnapshot.ps1` to capture a newer or revised release.

content.title: 2026-Oct Microsoft security release - KB to CVE mapping

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software" and SoftwareType =~ "Patch"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({InventoryFreshness})
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| where isempty('{SoftwareSearch}') or SoftwareName contains '{SoftwareSearch}'
| extend KB = toupper(extract(@"KB[0-9]{6,8}", 0, SoftwareName))
| extend UpdateIdentity = iff(isempty(KB), SoftwareName, KB)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, SoftwareName, CurrentVersion, Publisher, Architecture) by Computer, UpdateIdentity
| summarize InstalledComputers = dcount(Computer), Titles = make_set(SoftwareName, 5), Versions = make_set(CurrentVersion, 5), LastObserved = max(TimeGenerated) by UpdateIdentity, Publisher
| project UpdateIdentity, Publisher, InstalledComputers, Titles, Versions, LastObserved
| sort by InstalledComputers desc, UpdateIdentity asc
content.title: Compliance 2 and 3 - Installed update summary

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software" and SoftwareType =~ "Patch"
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| extend KB = toupper(extract(@"KB[0-9]{6,8}", 0, SoftwareName))
| where isnotempty(KB)
| summarize FirstObserved = min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, KB
| summarize Computers = dcount(Computer), Updates = dcount(KB) by bin(FirstObserved, 7d)
| sort by FirstObserved asc
content.title: Historical update adoption by first observation

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software" and SoftwareType =~ "Patch"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({InventoryFreshness})
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| where isempty('{SoftwareSearch}') or SoftwareName contains '{SoftwareSearch}'
| extend KB = toupper(extract(@"KB[0-9]{6,8}", 0, SoftwareName))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SoftwareName, CurrentVersion
| extend Architecture = iff(isempty(Architecture), case(SoftwareName has "x64" or SoftwareName has "amd64" or SoftwareName has "64-bit", "x64", SoftwareName has "x86" or SoftwareName has "32-bit", "x86", ""), Architecture)
| project Computer, KB, SoftwareName, CurrentVersion, Publisher, Architecture, LastObserved = TimeGenerated, ResourceId = _ResourceId
| sort by Computer asc, KB desc
content.title: Compliance 5 - Installed updates by computer

content.json:
## Software inventory
Comparable to SCCM Software 01A, 02D, 02E, and 06A reports.

content.query:
ConfigurationData
| where ConfigDataType =~ "Software" and SoftwareType in~ ("Application", "Package")
| where TimeGenerated >= ago({InventoryFreshness})
| extend NormalizedResourceId = tolower(_ResourceId)
| parse NormalizedResourceId with "/subscriptions/" AzureSubscriptionId "/resourcegroups/" AzureResourceGroup "/providers/" AzureResourceProvider "/" AzureResourceKind "/" *
| extend AzureResourceType = case(AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.compute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "virtualmachines", "Azure VM", AzureResourceProvider =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute" and AzureResourceKind =~ "machines", "Arc server", "Other")
| where "*" in~ ({AzureSubscription}) or AzureSubscriptionId in~ ({AzureSubscription})
| where "*" in~ ({ResourceGroup}) or AzureResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
| where "*" =~ {ResourceType} or AzureResourceType =~ {ResourceType}
| where "*" in~ ({Region}) or NormalizedResourceId in (arg("").Resources | where location in~ ({Region}) | project NormalizedResourceId = tolower(id))
| where isempty('{ComputerSearch}') or Computer contains '{ComputerSearch}'
| where isempty('{SoftwareSearch}') or SoftwareName contains '{SoftwareSearch}'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Publisher, Architecture, CurrentVersion) by Computer, SoftwareName
| extend Publisher = iff(isempty(Publisher), "Unknown", Publisher)
| extend Architecture = iff(isempty(Architecture), case(SoftwareName has "x64" or SoftwareName has "amd64" or SoftwareName has "64-bit", "x64", SoftwareName has "x86" or SoftwareName has "32-bit", "x86", ""), Architecture)
| summarize InstalledComputers = dcount(Computer), Versions = make_set(CurrentVersion, 8), Architectures = make_set(Architecture, 4), LastObserved = max(TimeGenerated) by SoftwareName, Publisher
| project SoftwareName, Publisher, InstalledComputers, Versions, Architectures, LastObserved
| top 1000 by InstalledComputers desc
content.title: Software 01A and 06A - Installed software summary
